promotions.title: Activate Money Safe, Get a Pacific Coffee Voucher
promotions.highlight: ☕️ Get a HKD30 Pacific Coffee e-Cash Voucher
promotions.description: Customers who deposit any amount into a 'Money Safe' account can receive a HKD30 Pacific Coffee e-Cash Voucher. Money Safe is an anti-fraud feature introduced by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority that maintains the same interest rates while providing stronger protection.
promotions.period: Limited quota, first come, first served
promotions.quota: Limited quota, first come, first served
promotions.cost: Deposit any amount into a Money Safe account

promotions.title: Fractional Share Investment
promotions.highlight: 🔢 Invest in stocks with minimal capital - 1 share for Hong Kong stocks, US$5 for US stocks
promotions.description: EleBank allows customers to invest in fractional shares, starting from just 1 share for Hong Kong stocks and US$5 for US stocks. This feature enables investors with limited capital to access a diverse range of stocks.

promotions.title: Flexible Time Deposit Options
promotions.highlight: 🔄 Open time deposits 24/7 with flexible terms
promotions.description: EleBank offers time deposits with flexible terms that can be opened 24/7 through the mobile app. Customers can enhance their returns with interest rate boost coupons for even higher yields.

promotions.title: EleBank Digital Banking 5-Minute Account Opening
promotions.highlight: ⏱️ Open an account in as fast as 5 minutes
promotions.description: Hong Kong residents and visitors can open an EleBank account in as little as 5 minutes using their mobile phones. This digital account opening service is available for all customers without the need to visit a branch.

promotions.title: 24/7 Digital Banking Services
promotions.highlight: 🕒 Round-the-clock online banking services
promotions.description: EleBank offers 24/7 online banking services through its mobile app and website. Customers can access their accounts and perform various transactions at any time, with 24-hour customer service hotline support.

promotions.title: Travel with Visa Card Flight Rebate
promotions.highlight: ✈️ Up to HKD800 cash rebate on flight bookings
promotions.description: Visa cardholders can enjoy up to HKD800 cash rebate when booking flights with Air New Zealand, ANA, Ethiopian Airlines, EVA AIR or Singapore Airlines through their official Hong Kong or Macau websites. Rebate amount depends on transaction value with HKD800 for transactions of HKD8,000+ and HKD240 for transactions between HKD4,000-7,999.
promotions.quota: Limited quota, first come, first served. Maximum one cash rebate per registered eligible Visa card.

promotions.title: No Account Management Fee and No Minimum Balance
promotions.highlight: 💰 Zero account management fees and no minimum deposit required
promotions.description: EleBank accounts come with no account management fees and no minimum balance requirements. Customers can maintain their accounts without worrying about monthly fees or minimum deposit thresholds.

promotions.title: Hong Kong Stocks Lifetime Commission-Free Trading
promotions.highlight: 🚫 Zero commission on Hong Kong stocks trading for life
promotions.description: EleBank offers lifetime commission-free trading for Hong Kong stocks. Customers still pay a platform fee of HKD15 per order, but no additional commission is charged. This benefit applies to accounts that completed opening during the eligible promotion period.
promotions.period: Ongoing for eligible accounts opened during the promotion period
promotions.quota: Limited to accounts opened during the promotion period
promotions.cost: HKD15 platform fee per order still applies

promotions.title: Personal Loan with Up to 12x Monthly Salary
promotions.highlight: 💸 Borrow up to 12 times your monthly salary
promotions.description: EleBank offers personal loans with amounts up to 12 times the borrower's monthly salary or HK$1,000,000, whichever is lower. The loan approval and disbursement process can be completed in as fast as 5 minutes.

promotions.title: Flexible Multi-Currency Savings Accounts
promotions.highlight: 💱 Hold multiple currencies with no minimum balance
promotions.description: EleBank offers multi-currency savings accounts with no minimum balance requirement. Customers can hold and manage funds in multiple currencies including HKD, USD, and RMB in a single account.

promotions.title: Real-time Securities Account Fund Transfer
promotions.highlight: ⚡ 24/7 real-time fund transfers between bank and securities accounts
promotions.description: EleBank offers 24/7 real-time fund transfers between bank accounts and securities accounts in HKD, USD, and RMB. This service allows investors to quickly move funds for trading opportunities at any time.

promotions.title: Low-Cost US Stock Trading
promotions.highlight: 💲 Trade US stocks for as low as US$1.99 per order
promotions.description: EleBank offers low-cost US stock trading with a total fee of US$0.0099 per share (minimum US$1.99 per order). This includes a commission of US$0.0049 per share (minimum US$0.99) and a platform fee of US$0.005 per share (minimum US$1.00).

promotions.title: Visa Platinum Card with Real-time Fraud Protection
promotions.highlight: 🛡️ 24/7 real-time fraud monitoring and protection
promotions.description: The EleBank Visa Platinum Card comes with a security shield feature that provides 24/7 real-time fraud monitoring and protection. This enhanced security helps detect and prevent fraudulent transactions on the card.
promotions.cost: Free with EleBank Visa Platinum Card

promotions.title: SME Loan Cash Rebate Promotion
promotions.highlight: 💵 Enjoy up to HK$100,000 cash rebate on first SME loan drawdown!
promotions.description: New SME customers can receive a cash rebate of up to HK$100,000 upon their first loan drawdown. This limited-time promotion aims to support small and medium enterprises with their financing needs.

promotions.title: Multi-Currency Savings Account Upgrade
promotions.highlight: 🌐 Support for HKD, RMB, and USD in one account!
promotions.description: The savings account has been upgraded to support multiple currencies including HKD, RMB, and USD. Users can now transfer directly from Deposit Plus to third-party accounts with daily transfer limits increased to up to HK$1 million.

promotions.title: Ant Bank Investment Fund Platform
promotions.highlight: 📈 New investment fund platform now available!
promotions.description: Ant Bank has launched a new investment fund platform offering high-quality funds from industry-leading companies including JP Morgan, Allianz, GF Fund, and China AMC. Minimum investment starts from as low as HK$1.

promotions.title: Insurance Products with Premium Rebate
promotions.highlight: 💯 Get 100% premium rebate on selected insurance products!
promotions.description: Ant Bank offers insurance products with a 100% premium rebate on selected plans. The service features a simple online application process with premium protection options all in one place.

promotions.title: Secure Storage Service
promotions.highlight: 🔒 Enhanced deposit protection against fraud!
promotions.description: Ant Bank has launched the Secure Storage Service, an anti-fraud measure introduced by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority. This service allows users to lock reserve deposits, preventing transfers through any channels including local and cross-border transfers, while still earning interest.

promotions.title: One-Stop Securities Trading Platform
promotions.highlight: 🌎 One-stop Hong Kong and US stock trading platform!
promotions.description: Ant Bank offers a comprehensive trading platform connecting Hong Kong and US stock markets for global investment opportunities. The service provides access to Hong Kong stocks, US stocks, ETFs and other global investment options with account opening in as fast as 3 minutes.
promotions.quota: Hong Kong residents only (not applicable to mainland and overseas users without Hong Kong resident identity)
promotions.cost: Trading fees apply as per terms and conditions

promotions.title: Balance+ Daily Interest Earning
promotions.highlight: 💰 Earn up to 2.0% p.a. interest daily!
promotions.description: Balance+ offers daily interest earning on your deposits with an annual interest rate of up to 2.0%. The feature allows flexible withdrawal without fees and provides enhanced financial security.

promotions.title: Time Deposit Service
promotions.highlight: 💼 Flexible time deposit with no penalty for early withdrawal!
promotions.description: Ant Bank offers time deposit options with customizable deposit periods and no penalty fees for early withdrawal. The service features a low minimum deposit of HK$1 and supports both HKD and USD deposits.

promotions.title: Personal Loan
promotions.highlight: 🔄 Revolving credit line with flexible withdrawals!
promotions.description: Ant Bank's personal loan offers a revolving credit line with flexible withdrawal options and instant fund disbursement. The service features simple application processes and transparent fee structures.

promotions.description: Enjoy free instant transfers via FPS. Receive HKD and CNY with just your mobile number and send Group Lai See with one tap without entering recipients individually.

promotions.highlight: 🔢 Choose the last 6 digits on your ZA Card
promotions.description: Personalize your ZA Card by selecting the last 6 digits on your card face. First bank in Hong Kong to offer this customization service for cardholders.

promotions.title: Free Cash Withdrawals Throughout Hong Kong
promotions.highlight: 💰 Withdraw cash for free at over 3,000 Visa ATMs across Hong Kong
promotions.description: ZA Card holders can withdraw cash without fees at more than 3,000 Visa ATMs throughout Hong Kong. International withdrawals may incur handling fees.

promotions.highlight: ⏱️ Get loan approval results in as fast as 90 seconds
promotions.description: Apply for loans with preliminary approval results in as fast as 90 seconds for new customers. Loan amounts up to HKD 1,000,000 available with rates as low as 1.30% APR.

promotions.highlight: 🛡️ Get insured in as fast as 3 minutes via your smartphone
promotions.description: Complete insurance applications in as fast as 3 minutes through the ZA Bank app. Options include life insurance, critical illness insurance, and Voluntary Health Insurance Scheme (VHIS).
promotions.cost: Varies by insurance type and coverage

promotions.title: ZA Bank 6th Anniversary StockBack Celebration
promotions.highlight: 🎉 Win stock rewards worth up to HKD 60,000 in the lucky draw
promotions.description: Comprehensive 6th anniversary campaign featuring multiple StockBack opportunities including app login lucky draw, coffee merchant spending rebates, and leaderboard competitions. Total prize pool worth HKD 6 million in stock rewards.
promotions.quota: Various quotas for different campaign components
promotions.cost: Free for lucky draw; spending required for rebates

promotions.title: ZA Card Statement Instalment Program - SURPRISE Promotion
promotions.highlight: 💰 Get up to HKD 2,000 cash reward
promotions.description: Apply for ZA Card Statement Instalment Program with promo code SURPRISE to receive additional cash rewards. Successfully withdraw from the program with a loan period of 18 months or more to receive cash rewards based on the loan amount.
promotions.cost: Minimum loan amounts starting from HKD 200,000

promotions.title: Refer-a-Friend Account Opening Rewards Campaign
promotions.highlight: 🤝 Earn up to HKD 90,000 for referring friends
promotions.description: Refer friends to open a ZA Bank account and earn rewards. Top 20 referrers in each of the 9 phases can earn up to HKD 10,000, plus additional rewards when referred friends meet deposit requirements.
promotions.quota: Multiple rewards based on referral performance

promotions.title: 20% p.a. HKD Time Deposit Offer for New Customers
promotions.highlight: 💰 Enjoy 20% p.a. interest on 7-day HKD time deposits
promotions.description: New customers who meet deposit requirements can receive a +19.9% p.a. 7-day HKD new fund time deposit interest rate boost coupon. Combined with the base interest rate, customers can enjoy a 20% annual interest rate.
promotions.quota: New customers who meet deposit requirements
promotions.cost: Minimum deposit of HKD 1,000 or equivalent

promotions.title: Multi-Currency Savings Account
promotions.highlight: 🌐 Hold and exchange 11 currencies in one account
promotions.description: Maintain savings in 11 different currencies including HKD, CNY, USD, GBP, SGD, EUR, CAD, AUD, JPY, NZD and CHF. Exchange currencies 24/7 at your preferred rates with no fees.

promotions.title: ZA Bank Crypto Trading Fee Waiver for New Customers
promotions.highlight: 💲 Zero platform fee for crypto trading for 90 days
promotions.description: New crypto users can enjoy 0 platform fee on crypto trading transactions executed within 90 days of activating the service. No cap on the number of eligible transactions or trading volume.
promotions.quota: First 90 days after activating crypto trading service for first-time users only

promotions.title: Stock PowerDraw Promotion
